title: A holiday treat you won’t feel guilty about sneaking a bite of. ✨🎄 Th...
description: A holiday treat you won’t feel guilty about sneaking a bite of. ✨🎄 This festive Christmas bark uses our Spinach Apple Sweet Potato pouch as the secret ingredient for natural sweetness and brain-boosting nutrients. Sweet, simple, and perfect for little hands (and big ones too). 😉 Ingredients: 1 pouch Cerebelly purée (any flavour you love — try Apple Kale or Sweet Potato Mango for color!) 1 cup Greek yogurt (plain or vanilla) Toppings: strawberries (red “ornaments”) kiwi (green “ornaments”) Mini holiday sprinkles Instructions: 1. In a bowl, stir together the Greek yogurt and Cerebelly purée. Taste and adjust sweetness if needed. 2. Line a small baking sheet or plate with parchment paper. Spread the yogurt mixture into a thin, even layer (about ½ inch thick). 3. Sprinkle with your festive toppings — think red, green, and white for Christmas vibes! 4. Place in the freezer for 2–3 hours, or until firm. 5. Break into pieces (like bark!) and store in a sealed container in the freezer for up to 1 month. . . . #cerebelly #toddlerrecipes #holidaybaking #momapproved #veggiesneak #brainfood #snacksmart

title: Frosty’s got some competition this holiday season. 😉☃️ This snowman c...
description: Frosty’s got some competition this holiday season. 😉☃️ This snowman cake pop recipe featuring our Cerebelly pouches is cute, cozy, and secretly veggie-powered. Ingredients: 1 pouch Cerebelly purée (≈100 g; any green variety like Spinach Apple Sweet Potato works great) 40 g baby spinach (lightly packed) 100 g very ripe banana (about 1 small banana) 2 eggs 150 g milk (about ⅔ cup; dairy or non-dairy) 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 1 teaspoon cinnamon (optional) 120 g whole wheat flour (about 1 cup, spooned and leveled) 2 teaspoons baking powder Instructions: 1. In a blender, combine the Cerebelly purée, spinach, banana, eggs, milk, vanilla, and cinnamon (if using). Blend until completely smooth and bright green. 2. In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour and baking powder.  3. Pour the blended mixture into the dry ingredients and stir gently until just combined. Don’t overmix — a few small lumps are fine. 4. Heat a lightly greased nonstick skillet over medium heat. Pour 2–3 tablespoons of batter per pancake. 5. Cook until bubbles form on top and edges look set (about 2–3 minutes), then flip and cook 1–2 minutes more.  6. Serve warm with yogurt, fruit, or a drizzle of maple syrup. . . . #cerebelly #holidaybaking #snacksmart #toddlersnacks #healthykids
